Introduction
This
document lists the inspection checks I2, which must be performed
every three months as indicated by
 M3
in the title block.
Safety
Precautions
Transformer
 isolation and earthing is required.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounded the work area is required.
Wear
 your safety helmet, safety shoes and safety harness
There
 is a danger of falling into containment pit when working near large power
 transformers.
A
 proper well-fixed ladder should be used for climbing on top of the
 transformer tank.
Tools
and Equipment
Fiberglass ladder dielectric strength oil tester
Voltmeter complete set of maintenance hand tools.
Safety helmet, safety shoes, and safety harness.
Work
to be Carried Out
Repeat
 steps of monthly inspection MPIS Document no. 
 T-015-r0.
